scope: Read-only diagnosis of the local approval blocker; not a hook repair or acceptance.

staticDiagnostic.inputKind: Existing quoted branch-creation command, treated only as data.

goalAudit.previousCompletedGoalTurn: Progress: read-only hook metadata narrowed the next diagnostic; the separately requested dashboard was shown.
goalAudit.priorFailedTurns: Usage-limit termination, not successful independent audits or new user authorization.

notPerformed: Executing the quoted branch command or governance handler
Repairing or disabling the global hook
Retrying the rejected spec amendment by another writer or obfuscated payload
Project source edits, commits, push, main creation, PR or merge
Changing or cancelling original brief requirements

verification.scopeLimit: Current regression suite and metadata consistency only; does not cover the unfixed D01 or prove G2/GO.

requiredUserDecisions: Authorize a narrowly scoped global hook correction without disabling protection, or provide an approved way to amend the literal contract documentation.
